anchor: Plan v10 Track SS — Spain 17 autonomous communities + Basque + Navarre foral regimes. Standard CIT 25% federal; Basque Country (Álava, Bizkaia, Gipuzkoa) + Navarre have own tax administration with similar but separately-administered rates.
convention: Standard CIT applies in 15 communities. Basque + Navarre operate independent regimes via 'Concierto Económico' / 'Convenio Económico'. canary_special applies in Canary Islands ZEC zone (4% CIT for qualifying entities).

default_country_rate.notes: Spanish CIT 25% standard, 15% for new companies first 2 profit years.

ES-CN.name: Canarias
ES-CN.notes: Standard, but ZEC zone qualifying entities pay 4% CIT (significant for some SMBs). IGIC 7% replaces VAT.

ES-NC.name: Navarra
ES-NC.notes: Foral regime via Convenio Económico — own tax administration. CIT 28% standard (24% small business).

ES-PV.name: País Vasco
ES-PV.notes: Foral regime via Concierto Económico. Three provinces (Álava, Bizkaia, Gipuzkoa) set rates. CIT 24% standard (most permissive), 20% small business.
